snippet.text: An acknowledge finding does not fail the status an Actions round sets, as [the decision](docs/decisions/2026-11-07-actions-round-sets-melian-review.md) records. So a pull request needs no host round when its `melian round` workflow run sets `melian/review` to `success` on the exact head, and the maintainer's read of each acknowledge finding is recorded on the pull request. Its builder marks it ready and queues it, from a cloud session through the REST routes in Working in a cloud session. A dismissal can be recorded only on the host, since an Actions round's store is thrown away. A policy notice prints as blocking on a workflow or configuration file and as acknowledge on AGENTS.md. A blocking one fails the status like any blocking finding, so it needs the host until a round can honour a dismissal; one at acknowledge needs the maintainer's read recorded, as above. This reading of the rule is the coordinator's. The maintainer agreed it on 2026-11-16, in the coordinator's session, with the ruling that builders finish clean pull requests themselves. [Pull request #499](https://github.com/melian-agent/melian/pull/499) landed this way.
